```plato
//==
// # Spatial primitives
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Oriented boxes
//  - Cylinders, cones, and capsules
//  - Flat patches in space
//  - Simplices and polyhedral solids
//  - Spheres and ellipsoids
//  - Tori

//==
// # Oriented boxes
//
// The rectangular solids: the oriented box and its Minkowski-rounded form. Size
// gives the FULL extents along the box's local axes, so every body halves them; a
// solid denotes the filled region including its boundary surface.

// An oriented solid box: Size gives the full extents along the box's local
// axes, oriented by Orientation about Center. Axis-aligned when Orientation is
// identity (prefer Bounds3D for that case). (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuboid)
type Box3D
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentered3D, IContainsPoint3D, INearestPoint3D, ISupport3D, IParametricSurface
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Size: Size3D;
    Orientation: Quaternion;
}

// A box with edges and corners rounded by CornerRadius: the Minkowski sum of a
// shrunken box and a ball. CornerRadius is clamped to half the smallest extent.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minkowski_addition)
type RoundedBox3D
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentroid3D, IContainsPoint3D, ISupport3D
{
    Box: Box3D;
    CornerRadius: Number;
}

//==
// # Cylinders, cones, and capsules
//
// The solids swept along an axis or a segment: the right circular cylinder and its
// hollow pipe form, the cone and the frustum that truncates it, and the capsule
// traced by sweeping a ball along a segment. Axes are unit directions and heights
// are FULL heights; a solid denotes the filled region including its boundary
// surface.

// A solid right circular cylinder with flat caps. Center is the midpoint of the
// axis segment; the cylinder extends Height/2 each way along Axis.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cylinder)
type Cylinder
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentered3D, IContainsPoint3D, ISupport3D, IParametricSurface
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    Radius: Number;
    Height: Number;
}

// The hollow region between two coaxial cylinders: a pipe / tube wall, closed
// by two flat annular caps. Center is the midpoint of the axis segment and the
// shell extends Height/2 each way along Axis.
// Invariant: 0 <= InnerRadius <= OuterRadius.
type CylindricalShell
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentered3D, IContainsPoint3D, IParametricSurface
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    Height: Number;
    InnerRadius: Number;
    OuterRadius: Number;
}

// A solid right circular cone. Axis points from Apex toward the base; the base
// is the disk of Radius at Apex + Axis * Height, and closes the solid.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cone)
type Cone
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentroid3D, IContainsPoint3D, ISupport3D, IParametricSurface
{
    Apex: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    Height: Number;
    Radius: Number;
}

// A cone with its tip cut off by a plane parallel to the base: a solid bounded
// by two parallel disks and the lateral surface. Center is the midpoint of the
// axis segment; the bottom disk (BottomRadius) sits at -Height/2 along Axis,
// the top disk (TopRadius) at +Height/2. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frustum)
type ConicalFrustum
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentroid3D, IContainsPoint3D, IParametricSurface
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    Height: Number;
    BottomRadius: Number;
    TopRadius: Number;
}

// All points within Radius of the segment from A to B: a cylinder with
// hemispherical ends. The smooth, convex sweep of a ball along a segment.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capsule_(geometry))
type Capsule3D
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentroid3D, IContainsPoint3D, INearestPoint3D, ISupport3D, IParametricSurface
{
    A: Point3D;
    B: Point3D;
    Radius: Number;
}

//==
// # Flat patches in space
//
// The two-dimensional patches embedded in 3D — a circular disk, a triangle, and a
// quadrilateral. Unlike the solids they are NOT filled regions: their `Area` is the
// patch's own area and their `Perimeter` its rim. The triangle's normal follows the
// right-hand rule around its stored vertex order.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding, handedness, and normals.

// A flat circular patch: the points of the plane through Center with the given
// Normal that lie within Radius of Center.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disk_(mathematics))
type Disk3D
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IManifold, IOrientable, IArea, IBounded3D, ICentered3D, INearestPoint3D
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Normal: Direction3D;
    Radius: Number;
}

// Three vertices in space; the fundamental rendering and meshing primitive.
// The normal follows the right-hand rule around A, B, C.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triangle)
type Triangle3D
    implements IGeometry3D, IConvexShape, IConnected, IManifold, IOrientable, IArea, IBounded3D, IPointSet3D, ICentroid3D, INearestPoint3D, IDeformable3D
{
    A: Point3D;
    B: Point3D;
    C: Point3D;
}

// Four vertices in order in space. Planar and convex in the ideal case;
// otherwise interpreted as the bilinear patch over its corners.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bilinear_interpolation)
type Quad3D
    implements IGeometry3D, IConnected, IOrientable, IArea, IBounded3D, IPointSet3D, ICentroid3D, IDeformable3D
{
    A: Point3D;
    B: Point3D;
    C: Point3D;
    D: Point3D;
}
```
